branches.theme: Standard Form and Solution by Factorization

details: Standard form: ax^2 + bx + c = 0 where a != 0.
Factorization involves splitting bx into two terms whose coefficients product equals a * c.

branches.theme: Quadratic Formula and Nature of Roots

details: D > 0: Two distinct real roots: x = (-b ± √D) / (2a).
D = 0: Two equal real roots: x = -b / (2a).
evidence_or_examples: 2x^2 + kx + 3 = 0 has equal roots when D = k^2 - 24 = 0 => k = ±2√6.

details: Translate physical constraints (speed, distance, time, area) into quadratic equations.
evidence_or_examples: Motorboat upstream/downstream: 24/(18-x) - 24/(18+x) = 1 => x^2 + 48x - 324 = 0 => stream speed x = 6 km/h.
